scripts.check: npm run build && node --check scripts/build-site.mjs && node --check src/worker.js && npm run check:apps
scripts.check:apps: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'); for (const name of fs.readdirSync('apps-script').filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.gs'))) { const file='apps-script/'+name; new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'),{filename:file}); }"
scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 3000 --directory dist
